purpose: Define PortfolioCore as the owner of identity-linked references and descriptive evidence metadata without owning merit scoring, recommendations, trust or Tier calculation.

topics.name: PortfolioCore
topics.purpose: Define PortfolioCore as the owner of identity-linked references and descriptive evidence metadata without owning merit scoring, recommendations, trust or Tier calculation.

semantics.evidence_rule: Portfolio entries reference evidence; they do not convert evidence into merit by themselves.
semantics.identity_rule: Portfolio entries belong to one explicit identity.
semantics.projection_rule: CV/profile views are projections over PortfolioCore plus other explicitly composed identity Topics, not PortfolioCore authority.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio evidence and merit semantics have explicit owners and cannot silently substitute for one another.

hard_gates.condition: portfolio reference treated as verified merit automatically
portfolio entry has no explicit owning identity

references.purpose: Portfolio entries bind to explicit identities.
